description: This file defines a Java interface 'TransactionPortionsForForeclosure' which specifies methods related to obtaining different portions (interest, fee charges, penalty charges) of a transaction for loan foreclosure purposes.

classes.name: TransactionPortionsForForeclosure
classes.description: A Java interface specifying methods to access different financial portions involved in a loan foreclosure transaction, including transaction type, interest, fee charges, and penalty charges.

methods.name: getTransactionType
methods.description: Returns the type of the loan transaction, represented by LoanTransactionType.

methods.name: getInterestPortion
methods.description: Returns the portion of interest involved in the transaction as BigDecimal.

methods.name: getFeeChargesPortion
methods.description: Returns the fee charges portion involved in the transaction as BigDecimal.

methods.name: getPenaltyChargesPortion
methods.description: Returns the penalty charges portion involved in the transaction as BigDecimal.
